reviews.text: For the past 16 years, my family and I have relied on Scott Dunlap Roofing Company for roofing services on over seven occasions across our properties. Each time, their work has been professional and highly satisfying. Not only can it provide quick service and a reasonable price, but Scott always deals with my insurance company for claims and follow-up.  He is always on top of everything, bringing me peace of mind.
reviews.author: Vicki Yue

reviews.text: We recently had our roof replaced by Scott Dunlap Roofing and we couldn’t be happier with the outcome.  Full tear off and replacement done in 1-day!  Tarps laid out around the house to catch those pesky nails. Then went around with a magnet to find any strays. First time we’ve had a roofer use tarps. Highly recommend if you’re in need of a roof or repairs now or in the future.
reviews.author: Steven Smith

reviews.text: Scott and his crew did great job to replace my roof damaged by last year's hail. Very easy to work with and always give prompt response for any questions. Strongly recommend!
reviews.author: Guangxu Li

reviews.text: Scott and his crew are amazing to work with.  Over the past several years, I've interacted with them on regular basis and am always amazed at their timely responses and professionalism.  Additionally, this company replaced the roof at my personal residence just a few months ago and we received nothing but fabulous service.  Dunlap Roofing - you've got a great team!
reviews.author: Jane White

reviews.text: Scott and his team did the great job for my house, they are very professional: They are detail oriented and take care of my needs, work around with my schedules, I will definitely recommend Scott Dunlap Roofing to all of my friends!
reviews.author: Sheryl2 Huang

reviews.text: Scott and his crews have been incredible. I have used Dunlap Roofing on a number of occasions and even referred several people their way. Have always gotten great feedback and I have nothing but good things to say about Scott and his guys. Keep up the good work!!
reviews.author: Texas Show Promoters

reviews.text:
**Highly recommend for your roofing and construction needs!

(Professional, craftsmanship, quality, fair, meticulous and efficient are some descriptors of what we experienced in our needs over the years.)

reviews.author: Justin Row

reviews.text: I have knowing Scot for over 12 years , he is honest, hardworking and never let me down. I have introduced him to all my friends and they are very happy with his work.
reviews.author: Fred Bech

data.summary: The 20 available reviews are highly positive and contain authentic details, suggesting a quality contractor. However, the perfect 5.0 score across a small number of reviews, with no critical feedback, is unusual and warrants caution. The reviews themselves do not show clear signs of being fake.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Some reviews lack specific project details
authentic_signals: Specific details in several reviews (tarps, magnets, hail damage, 1-day replacement)
Long-term customer relationships mentioned (16 years, 12 years)
Varied writing styles and reviewer names
Owner responses are personalized and professional
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available, showing a perfect 5.0 rating. No other platforms have ratings to compare.
